records.check: Dynamic Architecture v2 positioning is correct
records.evidence: M0 defines Dynamic Cognitive Architecture v2 as an upper cognitive integration view below Constitution, Cognitive OS, and Baseline v2.

records.check: Dynamic Architecture v2 does not replace Baseline
records.evidence: M0 preserves the engineering baseline and M0-M3 manifests record no baseline changes.
M1 defines additive planning candidates only and M1-M3 manifests record no active contract activation.
M1 boundary flows preserve evidence, candidate, admission, and fact precedence; M3 forbids cognitive or Runtime promotion into Reality facts.
M1 schema ownership and M2 responsibility scopes preserve source-owner precedence and one Writer per governed scope.
M2 owner conflict review reports no duplicate owner and no owner drift across fifteen reviewed assets.
M2 responsibility boundary matrix declares single_writer_per_scope=true and the conflict review reports no duplicate writer.
M3 runtime boundary matrix sets runtime_cognitive_owner=false and explicitly forbids Runtime Intent, Causal, Memory, Reality, Decision, and Value ownership.
M3 manifest records no Runtime files, APIs, adapters, cognitive Runtime, or migration changes.
M0-M3 preserve existing baselines, APIs, owners, and the legacy A3 Runtime while treating new cognitive elements as planning references.
M1 supplies candidate-alias rollback definitions and later phases activate none of those candidates or alter active assets.
M0-M3 consistently deny PCN ownership, persistence, mutation, direct Runtime invocation, and ownership of Self, Role, Relationship, Memory, Emotion, or Value.
M3 records five future Runtime gaps with runtime_required=false and six adapter candidates with implementation_created=false.
Every M0-M3 change manifest and phase contract records migration_executed or Migration as false.
